title: Accounts Assistant
description:
RECfinancial are exclusively recruiting on behalf of a well-established and growing organisation, who are looking to appoint an Accounts Assistant to join their finance team on a full-time, permanent basis.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a friendly and supportive finance team, where the successful candidate will receive ongoing guidance and encouragement to develop their skills and progress within the role.

The organisation is also keen to support the successful candidate's long-term career development, with the opportunity to undertake or continue professional accountancy studies once established in the position. This role would suit someone looking to build a long-term career in finance within an environment that actively invests in its people.

This role would be commutable from Market Harborough, Thurnby, Scraptoft, Syston, Melton Mowbray and Leicestershire

Main role of Accounts Assistant

To ensure the accurate and timely processing of client invoicing, while providing support with financial reporting and forecasting to assist the Senior Management Team in effective business planning and decision-making.

The Accounts Assistant will take ownership of the end-to-end invoicing process, ensuring all financial records are maintained accurately and efficiently. The role will also involve supporting the preparation of financial reports, analysing key data and providing meaningful insights to assist the wider management team in making informed business decisions.

As a valued member of the team, the successful candidate will demonstrate professionalism, attention to detail and a proactive approach, consistently reflecting the values and standards of this successful and growing business.

Responsibilities of the Accounts Assistant
- Maintaining the Sales Ledger.
- Allocate and reconcile payments.
- Assist with chasing outstanding debts and maintaining low debtor days.
- Responsible for day-to-day management of client invoicing and related financial data.
- May liaise directly with customers to resolve invoice or payment queries.
- Identify and report potential cost-saving opportunities.
- Collaborates effectively with various internal teams to ensure billing accuracy.
- Plus any ad hoc finance duties.

Skills and Experience:
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- A flexible and strong team player with effective interpersonal skills.
- Takes ownership of assigned financial processes and meets deadlines.
- Communicates clearly and confidently with internal and external stakeholders.

In return our clients offer a long-term career opportunity in a reputable, established organisation, in a fantastic environment.

On offer is the following:
- £26,000k - £30,000k
- Free Parking on site
- Fantastic opportunity
- Great Holiday allowance
- Company Pension
- Good office facilities on site

Please apply through the website if you are interested in this fantastic opportunity.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Credit Controller

We are looking for an experienced and proactive Credit Controller to join our team in Daventry.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who can hit the ground running, take ownership of the credit control process and confidently manage both billing and the day-to-day finance administration associated with customer accounts.

You will need to be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing your own workload and ensuring payments are received promptly, accounts are kept up to date and reconciliations are completed accurately.

Key Responsibilities:
- Managing customer billing and ensuring invoices are raised accurately and on time.
- Proactively chasing outstanding debt and managing aged debt balances.
- Building and maintaining positive relationships with customers to ensure timely payment.
- Allocating and processing customer receipts.
- Managing debt payments and investigating any discrepancies or queries.
- Completing daily and periodic bank reconciliations.
- Reconciling customer accounts and resolving outstanding issues.
- Investigating and resolving payment and invoice queries.
- Maintaining accurate financial records and ensuring the sales ledger is kept up to date.
- Supporting the wider finance team with day-to-day duties where required.

About You

We are looking for someone who:
- Has previous experience in a Credit Control or Sales Ledger role.
- Has strong billing, cash allocation and debt-chasing experience.
- Is confident completing bank reconciliations.
- Has excellent attention to detail and strong numerical skills.
- Can work independently and manage their own workload effectively.
- Is organised, proactive and confident communicating with customers.
- Can hit the ground running and make an immediate contribution to the finance team.

Experience with Navision is desirable but not essential. Experience using other accounting or ERP systems will also be considered.

What's on Offer?
- Salary of up to 35,000, depending on experience.
- Semi-hybrid working available.
- Initially, the role will require 5 days per week in the office to allow you to get up to speed and settle into the business.
- The opportunity to join a busy finance team in a varied, hands-on position.

If you're an experienced Credit Controller looking for your next opportunity and can bring the skills and experience needed to make an immediate impact, we'd love to hear from you!
